# Dataset card (generated by `build.py final`)

Final items: **1770** (choice: 500, score: 500, noul: 500, tweets: 150, hallucination: 120).

Every item went through: plan with the label fixed in advance -> text written by an agent -> blind labelling by another agent -> adjudication (Claude Opus, human-supervised) of every disagreement or case flagged as ambiguous -> random audit of 5% of the agreed cases.

- Cases reviewed in adjudication: 285 (kept 183, relabelled 25, dropped 77).
- Random audit: 92 items reviewed, 0 with errors. 95% upper bound on the label error of non-adjudicated items: ~3.3%.
